Question: Aslam o alaikum can i write hadeeth with the name of narrater copied from either internet or book like fazayl sadqat and thn forward it to my friend. Question is tht it is allow to send hadith to others.if yes thn in which conditi??ns and wht care or precautions i should take? Jazak ALLAH KHAIRAN Answer ID: 8038 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1836/153=B/1429) Yes, you can write. It is right to send Hadith to others through internet. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
